text:
maria: quick PSA — running the new sampleapp (node) against /embeddings + rerank. When I send a batch of 2 texts, Node SDK returns embedding arrays that look double-sized (e.g. 3072) while python sample returns 1536. Also saw occasional 401 mid-batch and the node retry seems to make the shape explosion worse. Anyone seen this?

kevin: which SDK version and minimal repro?

maria: node sdk v0.14.2. minimal (trimmed):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw-embed-large', input: ['a', 'b'] });
console.log(res.data.map(r => r.embedding.length)); // -> [3072, 3072] (expected [1536,1536])
```
logs show a 401 in the middle then a 200: 
```
2025-10-12T14:02:00Z GET /token 401
2025-10-12T14:02:01Z RETRY batch id=ab12 status=200
2025-10-12T14:02:01Z embeddings: item0.len=3072
```

zach: I ran into a similar thing last week. The batching helper in node merges per-item arrays using `acc = acc.concat(item.embedding)` instead of pushing into an array of arrays, so if a retry re-invokes the merger you end up concatenating twice. Also the retry wrapper doesn't set an idempotency key for the whole batch.

sophia: yup — separate bug: auth refresh triggers a retry path that replays the original batch instead of resuming. Combined with the concat bug you see doubled vectors. The python helper builds `[[...],[...]]` correctly, node had an optimization to flatten and reconstruct but the reconstruct step had an index bug.

ryan: reproduced with this tiny script (node v20):
```js
async function repro() {
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: 'REPRO' });
  const res = await client._internal._batchEmbed(['x','y']); // internal helper call in repro
  console.log(JSON.stringify(res.data.map(r=>r.embedding.length)));
}
repro();
```
Result: `[3072,3072]`. If I set BATCH_SIZE=1 it returns `[1536,1536]` so batching is definitely the culprit.

sdk-bot: deploy-bot: CI for `fix/embeddings-batch-concat` (PR #2045) passed on canary. Canary `0.14.3-rc` includes a fix to batching helper + idempotency header.

zach: PR will also add a test that asserts each returned `embedding.length === model.dim` for each item, and add an integration test that simulates a 401 mid-stream. Workaround until patch: set BATCH_SIZE=1 or pin python SDK in onboarding docs.

maria: also noticed rerank response shape drift in the sample app — the new backend returns rerank info under `item.rerank.scores` instead of `item.score`. Client mapping code crashes. We need a compatibility shim in the node SDK to accept both `score` and `rerank.scores` formats.

kevin: filed DEVEX-789 to track follow-ups (shims + docs + add to onboarding checklist).

sophia: thumbs up. I'll add a short note to the sampleapp README about pinning SDK version and adding a `--batch-size` env override for quick repro.

maria: awesome, thanks. Leaving this here in case anyone else hits weird embedding dims or mid-batch 401s — we should get the rc out and update onboarding before the next cohort. :thumbsup:
